## Policy ID

<!-- The kebab-case ID of the policy this evidence relates to (e.g., "once-only-principle"). Find IDs at data/policies.ts or in the app's URL. -->

## Evidence Type

<!-- Select one: -->

- [ ] Supports the recommendation
- [ ] Weakens the recommendation
- [ ] Updates/refines the recommendation (e.g., newer data replaces older estimates)
- [ ] Addresses an open question listed in the policy

## Source Citation

<!-- Full citation. Preferred format: Authors (Year). Title. Institution/Journal. URL -->

## Key Finding

<!-- Summarise the key finding relevant to this policy in 2–4 sentences. Be precise: quote statistics, effect sizes, or confidence intervals where available. Do not paraphrase in a way that changes the meaning. -->

## Confidence Level

<!-- How confident are you that this evidence is reliable and applicable to the German context? -->

- [ ] High — peer-reviewed, large sample, replicable, directly applicable to Germany
- [ ] Medium — credible source, some limitations or indirect applicability
- [ ] Low — preliminary findings, small sample, significant context differences
- [ ] Uncertain — cannot assess without specialist knowledge

## Context Transferability

<!-- Does this evidence come from outside Germany? If so, explain what differences might affect whether the findings apply to Germany (institutional, legal, cultural, economic). -->
